baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperative at focus word 1 governs the punishment-and-pain phrase at words 2-3.
baseline_models.mechanism: A speech form whose default force brightens the hearer's face is forced to carry punitive pain. The positive delivery frame and negative payload do not cancel each other; their collision makes the utterance a taunt and presents the outcome as settled enough to announce.

activation_trace.role: Face-brightening tidings supplies the normally positive speech act whose forced reversal creates the taunt.
Torment and punishment fixes the announced content as punitive severity rather than ordinary news.
Pain-causing force makes the punishment's effect experiential and completes the reversal of the tiding.

changed_reading.before: Tell them that a painful punishment awaits.
changed_reading.after: Deliver the painful sentence in the very form reserved for face-brightening news, so that the announcement itself reverses expectation and signals certainty.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The command at word 1 can activate a branch of the same root concerned with visible forerunners, while words 2-3 name the completed painful event.
baseline_models.mechanism: The announcement can function as an advance visible trace of what follows. On this reading, speech is not merely information about a remote future; it is the first perceptible edge of the punishment entering the addressees' horizon.

activation_trace.role: First visible signs and forerunners turn the announcement into the initial appearance of the coming event.
Punitive severity supplies the full event of which the tiding is read as an onset signal.
Felt pain gives the announced process an experiential terminus rather than leaving it as an abstract forecast.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports a future punishment.
changed_reading.after: The report is itself the first visible streak of that punishment, an onset rather than a detached prediction.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Focus word 2 is anchored in the punishment branch but shares its root inventory with withholding and weaning; word 3 requires the resulting state to hurt.
baseline_models.mechanism: Punishment may operate privatively as well as additively. The same root field permits severe penalty to be imagined as forced abstention, deprivation, or weaning away from what sustained the addressees, with the adjective specifying that the separation is painful.

activation_trace.role: The tiding frame announces a change of condition rather than identifying the punishment's material by itself.
The ordinary punishment branch keeps the model anchored in punitive consequence.
Withholding and weaning supply a privative mechanism by which punishment can be inflicted.
Causing pain distinguishes punitive deprivation from neutral cessation.

changed_reading.before: Punishment is an added harmful force.
changed_reading.after: Punishment may also be a painful cutting-off or enforced weaning from security, sustenance, or relation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Words 1 and 2 each possess a pleasant branch image in their focus inventories, while word 3 explicitly imposes pain.
baseline_models.mechanism: The phrase crosses two ordinary channels of delight: news that opens the face and sweetness that pleases the palate. Pain corrupts both at once, producing more than verbal irony; the addressees' anticipated facial and sensory responses are inverted together.

activation_trace.role: Face-brightening news supplies the first positive response channel that the phrase overturns.
Fresh sweet palatability supplies a second, gustatory channel of attraction latent in the punishment root.
The punishment branch prevents the sweetness activation from replacing the focus noun's punitive sense.
Felt pain breaks both the facial promise of good news and the palate's promise of sweetness.

changed_reading.before: A positive news formula is used sarcastically for punishment.
changed_reading.after: The wording stages a double sensory betrayal: what should brighten the face and taste sweet arrives as felt pain.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence dismantles enclosure above and below: the canopy splits, the lower surface extends, its contents are cast out, and it is left empty. Against that sequence, focus branches for stripping a surface and standing open to the sky make punishment readable as radical exposure, with pain arising from the loss of every sheltering layer.

activation_trace.role: Stripping an outer skin gives the tiding an exposing action rather than a merely verbal one.
Being uncovered beneath the sky supplies the privative spatial form of punishment.
Pain-causing force marks exposure as harmful rather than liberating.
The overhead canopy supplies the cover whose rupture begins the exposure mechanism.
Splitting and opening converts the canopy from protection into a breached surface.
The lower realm opposite the sky supplies the second boundary that is transformed.
Casting something out materializes the removal of what had been enclosed.
Emptiness and bareness complete the sequence from covered container to exposed remainder.

structural_cues: 84:1-5 pairs upper and lower cosmic surfaces and repeats their compelled response after both boundaries are opened.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: upper and lower surfaces split, cast out, and empty beside focus images of stripping and sky-exposure. Reader: cosmic loss of cover is taken as a model for what punishment does to the addressees. Live alternative: the openings only stage judgment and do not define the punishment itself.

changed_reading.before: Painful punishment is a harmful thing imposed on them.
changed_reading.after: Painful punishment can be the removal of every cover: the sentence strips, opens, and leaves the addressees exposed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The cosmos listens and accepts what is due, whereas the human audience hears recitation without lowering itself and instead assigns falsehood to it. The ironic tiding is therefore the terminal form of a failed communication: a message refused as guidance returns as an unavoidable painful message.

activation_trace.role: The news-giving branch keeps punishment inside the surah's repeated communication-and-reception mechanism.
Punitive severity is the changed form taken by the message after refusal.
Causing pain makes the final communication experiential and no longer dismissible as speech alone.
Listening with acceptance establishes successful reception as the cosmic comparator.
Binding due-ness joins reception to an obligation that the cosmos fulfills.
Reading and recitation supply the message presented to the resistant audience.
Lowering and submission name the reception response withheld by the audience.
Assigning falsehood identifies active rejection rather than simple failure to hear.

structural_cues: 84:2 and 84:5 repeat cosmic listening and due response; 84:20-22 answers that pattern with human non-belief, non-prostration, and denial.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: accepted command, recited message, refused lowering, denial, and a final tiding. Reader: these are linked as successive outcomes of one reception process, with pain making the refused message unavoidable. Live alternative: the final command is simply retributive speech after denial, not a transformed communication channel.

changed_reading.before: The tiding is a sarcastic threat following disbelief.
changed_reading.after: The tiding is guidance's rejected message returning in a painful form that can no longer be refused at the level of experience.

context_deltas.mechanism: Human toil leaves scratches and can mar a surface; the laborer then meets what the labor produced, while the book fixes it as an obligating record. Activated against the focus skin/surface branch, painful punishment becomes the legibility of accumulated action on the person rather than an unrelated external blow.

activation_trace.role: Visible outer skin or surface supplies the field on which accumulated action can become legible.
Punishment turns the visible record from neutral inscription into consequence.
Felt pain makes the record bodily borne rather than merely viewed.
What a person encounters of good or evil supplies the return of the life-course to its doer.
A scratch or bite mark gives toil a material capacity to leave traces.
Marring a face sharpens the link between labor's trace and the focus root's visible human surface.
A written fixing that obligates judgment converts traces of toil into an adjudicable record.

structural_cues: 84:6 repeats the toil root as agent-state and action, ends in encounter, and is followed immediately by the two record-receiving trajectories.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: toil can scratch or mar, the laborer meets an outcome, and writing fixes a judgment. Reader: the marks are treated as accumulated action becoming visible punishment on the doer. Live alternative: the scratch branches are only material analogies and the punishment remains wholly external.

changed_reading.before: A sentence announces punishment assigned after judgment.
changed_reading.after: The sentence announces the painful visibility of the addressees' own accumulated toil, fixed as record and returned to its makers.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired delivery of records, the act of accounting, and the opposition between concealment and exposure turn the focus announcement into formal service of an adjudicated result. Its irony remains, but the imperative also performs promulgation: a due judgment is made known to those recorded under it.

activation_trace.role: Giving tidings supplies the formal act by which an already determined result is communicated.
Punishment identifies the communicated result as a sentence rather than neutral information.
Pain-causing effect states what execution of the sentence does to its recipients.
Fixed obligation and desert supply the judgment's due character.
Writing that establishes an obligating ruling supplies the documentary basis of the sentence.
Counting and account supply the procedure that differentiates outcomes.
Putting something behind visibility supplies the adverse record's attempted concealment.
Emergence and exposure reverse concealment and make the sentence publicly legible.

structural_cues: 84:7-12 presents two procedural paths through record delivery, accounting, return, ruin, and fire before the focus command.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: due-ness, obligating writing, account, concealment, exposure, and news delivery. Reader: the final announcement is taken to officialize an adjudicated result, not just predict it. Live alternative: the records establish certainty while the imperative remains purely rhetorical taunting.

changed_reading.before: The command rhetorically mocks the condemned with bad news.
changed_reading.after: The command also serves the sentence: it formally discloses a due, recorded, and pain-causing judgment to its recipients.

context_deltas.mechanism: One figure returns joyfully to kin, while the other had been privately joyful among kin because he expected no return. The focus's cheerful-face and good-news images are therefore not generic sarcasm: they return the second figure's sheltered joy to him with its face turned into pain.

activation_trace.role: Cheerful openness of face supplies the affective surface that the punishment announcement reverses.
Face-brightening tidings make the reversal operate through the same channel as the earlier joy.
Punishment turns mirrored affect into retributive consequence.
Causing pain names the new affective and bodily value of the returned joy-form.
Turning a thing away from its face supplies the exact operation performed on the positive tiding form.
Return and destination establish the motion by which each figure reaches a contrasting outcome.
The near group of belonging supplies the shelter within which the condemned figure's joy had been sustained.
Hidden joy and ease identify the affective state that is later returned in inverted form.
Returning with diminution breaks the condemned figure's premise that no return would occur.

structural_cues: 84:9 and 84:13 repeat the kin-and-joy configuration but place it on opposite sides of return and accounting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: two kin-group joys, return language, a branch that turns a thing from its face, and punitive tidings. Reader: the focus is read as a measured reversal of the condemned figure's prior sheltered joy. Live alternative: the repetitions contrast destinies without implying affective repayment.

changed_reading.before: The good-news form is a general mockery.
changed_reading.after: The good-news form gives the condemned his former private joy back with its face reversed, making pain the destination of misread security.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier fire sequence gives generic punishment a heat-bearing medium. When that is combined with the focus branch of direct skin contact, the announcement removes distance between body and consequence: pain is transmitted by encounter rather than contemplated as a remote sentence.

activation_trace.role: Direct skin contact supplies immediate bodily adjacency to the announced consequence.
Torment keeps contact within the punishment frame rather than ordinary touch.
Aching supplies the body's registered effect of contact.
Meeting fire and its heat gives the punishment a material encounter surface.
Ignition and burning supply the energy transferred through that encounter.

structural_cues: 84:11 moves from calling for ruin directly into 84:12's encounter with blazing fire.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: an encounter with ignited fire, focus punishment, focus pain, and a branch of direct skin contact. Reader: contact is treated as the mechanism by which the announced pain becomes immediate. Live alternative: the focus remains generic, with fire only one previously named instance of punishment.

changed_reading.before: The punishment is a remote object of announcement.
changed_reading.after: The announcement forecasts the collapse of distance between skin and burning consequence, making punishment an immediate heat-bearing encounter.

context_deltas.mechanism: Twilight appears, night gathers, the moon reaches completion, and riders pass through superposed states. This ordered maturation strongly activates the focus branch of first visible signs: the tiding is a threshold marker in an already advancing process, not a notice about one isolated future event.

activation_trace.role: First visible signs turn the command into a threshold appearance within a developing sequence.
Punishment supplies the process toward which the threshold points.
Felt pain identifies the experiential direction of the developing process.
The red afterglow supplies a visible transitional sign rather than a stable endpoint.
Night and darkness supply the next temporal state after the threshold glow.
Gathering dispersed things gives night an accumulative rather than merely dark function.
Completion and evenness supply maturation from gathered fragments to a full state.
Moonlight in the sky makes completion visibly readable.
One thing mounted over another supplies the superposition of successive states.
State after state gives the transition sequence its explicit temporal architecture.

structural_cues: 84:16-19 advances from twilight to gathering night, completed moon, and state upon state before the refusal sequence begins.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: a visible threshold, gathering, completion, layering, and the focus's forerunner branch. Reader: the focus announcement is placed as another threshold in that process, with punishment already beginning to appear. Live alternative: the oath sequence proves transformation generally but does not time the punishment's onset.

changed_reading.before: The command announces one later punitive event.
changed_reading.after: The command is a visible threshold in a layered transition already underway, announcing the painful direction in which the addressees are moving.

context_deltas.mechanism: Denial covers truth while inward content is collected and held; superior knowledge penetrates that container. The focus news-act then strips the protective surface and externalizes the concealed content as a painful verdict. Punishment is thus disclosure as well as penalty.

activation_trace.role: Visible outer surface supplies the apparent layer opposed to inwardly stored content.
Stripping the outer surface gives announcement a revelatory operation.
News delivery is the act that makes the previously concealed judgment known.
Punishment turns disclosure of contents into adverse consequence.
Pain-causing effect makes exposure itself costly to those exposed.
Covering truth supplies the defensive concealment that the announcement reverses.
Attributing falsehood identifies the content-level distortion beneath the cover.
Disclosure to the knower supplies access that is not blocked by the addressees' surface.
Holding meaning in the heart supplies the inward content subject to disclosure.
Collecting a thing in a container gives concealment a spatial mechanism that can be opened.

structural_cues: 84:22-24 moves without a scene break from covering and denial to knowledge of stored contents and then, with a sequential connector, to punitive announcement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: truth-covering, false attribution, inward containment, comprehensive knowing, surface-stripping, and news. Reader: the stored content is taken to become the disclosed basis of the verdict. Live alternative: knowledge guarantees accuracy but the punishment need not itself be an act of exposure.

changed_reading.before: The punishment follows denial as an externally assigned consequence.
changed_reading.after: The punishment also exposes what denial had covered: hidden content is brought through the surface and announced back as a painful verdict.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate exception opens a contrary regime of recompense that is explicitly not cut off. That contrast sharpens the focus root's withholding-and-weaning branch: punitive pain can consist in severance from an extension that remains available, without interruption, to the excepted group.

activation_trace.role: The tiding announces which of the two immediately contrasted regimes applies to its recipients.
Withholding and weaning supply severance as the negative regime's mechanism.
Punishment keeps the proposed severance within the focus word's direct punitive sense.
Pain-causing force specifies that being cut away from the positive regime hurts.
Recompense for work supplies the positive good from which the negative regime diverges.
Otherness, exception, and negation articulate the contrast between the two recipient groups.
Cutting and diminishing until extension ends supplies the interruption explicitly denied of the reward.

structural_cues: 84:25 immediately excepts a group from the focus addressees and ends the surah with recompense characterized by non-interruption.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: focus withholding, an excepted recompense, and denial of cutting or exhaustion. Reader: the positive side's non-severance is used as a mirror that sharpens punishment into painful severance. Live alternative: the final adjective contrasts only reward duration and says nothing about punishment's mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Punishment adds pain to the condemned, while the next verse separately promises reward.
changed_reading.after: The two outcomes also divide by continuity: one group receives uncut recompense, while the other is painfully weaned away from that continuing good.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant split mapping from the sky root to the marking root, not the ordinary sky inventory. It remains anchored because a visible diagnostic mark meets the focus root's surface and forerunner branches. Downstream prose should present it only as an exploratory omen analogy, never as the lexical meaning of the sky word.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus word 1 can denote a visible surface and first signs; words 2-3 specify that what those signs announce is punitive pain.

activation_trace.role: Visible surface supplies the plane on which an announcing mark could appear.
First visible signs give the mark prospective force as a forerunner.
Punishment identifies the event diagnosed by the omen-like mark.
Pain-causing effect fixes the mark's announced direction as adverse.
A visible mark that makes a thing known turns the cosmic surface into a possible announcement medium.
A sign from which an observer reads a condition makes the mark diagnostic rather than decorative.

changed_reading.before: The punishment is announced verbally after cosmic signs.
changed_reading.after: The opened cosmic surface itself can be carried as an omen-like mark that makes the painful outcome visibly readable before speech completes the announcement.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a remote focus branch joining tongue-tip, whip-end, cord, and dangling attachment. It remains valid as a material analogy because the focus is an imperative speech act and the context repeatedly calls and recites before pain. Downstream prose should qualify it as an image of speech beginning execution, not as a lexical gloss of punishment.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The imperative at word 1 is uttered through speech, while focus word 2 has a branch encompassing both tongue-tip and whip-end and word 3 marks pain.

activation_trace.role: News-giving supplies the uttered act whose instrument can be reimagined materially.
The shared image of tongue-tip and whip-end lets the verbal edge double as a punitive striking edge.
Causing pain gives the doubled tongue-and-lash image its adverse effect.
Calling through speech establishes a voiced action immediately adjacent to punishment scenes.
Recitation supplies the prior verbal medium that the audience refused to receive.

changed_reading.before: Speech reports a punishment that will be executed separately.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the tongue that announces the sentence already becomes its lash-tip, so utterance is imagined as the first painful stroke.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the focus punishment root's womb-and-afterbirth branch across the earth's expulsion sequence. It remains anchored in that supplied branch, the painful adjective, and the focus forerunner image. Downstream prose should keep it as a material birth analogy for consequence emerging from emptied contents, not as a biological claim or a replacement meaning for punishment.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus word 2 supplies the remote womb-and-afterbirth branch, word 3 supplies pain, and word 1 can mark first visible emergence.

activation_trace.role: First visible emergence supplies the onset of something brought out after an interior process.
Womb and afterbirth supply the remote material image of consequence expelled after a world-scale convulsion.
Punishment keeps the expelled afterproduct tied to adverse consequence rather than free association.
Aching makes emergence laborious and harmful in the analogy.
Casting out gives the earth an expulsive action that can activate the afterbirth image.
Becoming empty supplies the completed state of an interior that has discharged its contents.

changed_reading.before: Punishment descends on the addressees from outside after the world changes.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, punishment is the painful afterproduct expelled when the world's concealed contents are brought out and its interior is emptied.

strongest_changes: The positive tiding form becomes both taunt and formal service of an already adjudicated sentence.
The final message answers failed reception: recitation refused as guidance returns as pain that must be experienced.
Cosmic opening and concealed-content language recast punishment as stripping, exposure, and disclosure.
The twilight-to-layer sequence turns the announcement into the first visible threshold of a process already underway.
The uncut reward contrast sharpens a coexisting privative reading of punishment as painful severance.
summary.what_was_special: The focus phrase concentrates reversals across face, palate, surface, message, and social joy. Context does not collapse these into one interpretation: it makes the same brief imperative function as ironic news, judicial notification, onset signal, exposure event, embodied encounter, and severance, while branch-distant mark, tongue-lash, and afterbirth images remain explicitly contained.
remaining_uncertainties: The surface, contact, sweetness, withholding, and womb activations are root-branch resonances rather than claims that those remote branches replace the focus words' ordinary senses.
It remains uncertain whether the announcement itself begins punishment or only makes an independently future sentence certain.
The disclosure model may describe the basis of judgment without defining the punishment's experienced form.
The non-dominant sky-to-mark activation should remain an omen analogy because the packet's split mapping is formally available but semantically distant.
